propositions: MCP container claim fails because op-cert key resolution finds no key: env var REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH is unset, genesis file .opcert-key is absent, and ContextVar binding is not observed on tool-call paths

The Ed25519 key file is already bind-mounted at /run/secrets/opcert-ed25519-key but the environment variable pointing to it is missing from both the compose mcp service and the autodeploy.sh blue-green docker run
Both launch paths (docker-compose.yml mcp service and autodeploy.sh mcp_run_new) must be fixed together to maintain parity, with compose as the source of truth
Setting REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH env override provides a thread- and context-independent fallback for op-cert key resolution, unlike the ContextVar binding
REBAR_IDENTITY_SIGNING_KEY must remain set on both paths as it serves dual purposes: populating cfg.identity.signing_key and providing input to compose_startup_opcert_binding
